name: INSEE SIRENE
description: Official French registry of legal units and establishments, updated daily. Look up SIREN/SIRET records or search by creation date, activity, geography, legal category, employer status, and other SIRENE fields. Free public plan with a self-service INSEE API key.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: INSEE public API key
credential_fields.description: Create a free application at portail-api.insee.fr, subscribe it to API Sirene's Public plan, and copy the generated API key.

tools.name: get_service_information
tools.description: Get SIRENE API service status, dataset dates, and version information.

tools.name: get_legal_unit
tools.description: Get one French legal unit and its current/historical periods by nine-digit SIREN.

tools.name: search_legal_units
tools.description: Search French legal units using SIRENE query syntax. Useful for recent creations, ceased companies, legal categories, activity codes, employer status, and denomination searches.

q.description: SIRENE query, for example `dateCreationUniteLegale:[2026-08-01 TO 2026-08-22] AND etatAdministratifUniteLegale:A`.

curseur.description: Cursor returned by a previous large-result request.

tools.name: get_establishment
tools.description: Get one establishment and its current/historical periods by fourteen-digit SIRET.

tools.name: search_establishments
tools.description: Search establishments using SIRENE query syntax. Use this for location-level lead generation such as new establishments in a commune, relocated sites, activity codes, head offices, or hiring-size proxies.

q.description: SIRENE query, for example `codeCommuneEtablissement:75056 AND etatAdministratifEtablissement:A`.

curseur.description: Cursor returned by a previous request.

tools.name: search_establishment_links
tools.description: Search establishment succession links, useful for identifying predecessor/successor sites and relocation-like changes.

q.description: Succession-link query using the API's indexed fields.
